data.name: Azratun
data.gender_notes: Azratun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rooted in Arabic language, 'Azratun' signifies the highest form of divine grace and supreme blessing bestowed upon an individual. The name Azratun carries the meaning “Divine Grace, Supreme Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azratun usually hope their child will grow to embody divine grace, supreme blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, 'Azratun' is believed to be a name inspired by Allah's infinite mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Azratun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Grace, Supreme Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azratun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عزرتون
in_arabic.long_meaning: عزرتون هو اسم من اسماء الله الحسنى في اللغة العربية، مشتق من عزر، يعني العزة و الرفعة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و العظمة

in_urdu.name: عزرتون
in_urdu.meaning: عزرتون اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے

in_hindi.name: अज़रतून

in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़रतून का अर्थ है सम्मान और गरिमा, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका संबंध कुरआन और हदीस में वर्णित ईश्वरीय गुणों से है

in_pashto.name: عزرتون
